page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.12xlarge is an x86_64 server operating on a KVM hypervisor, equipped with 48 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is configured with 186.0 GB of RAM, providing approximately 3.88 GB of memory per core. For hardware acceleration, the server features two NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs with a combined total of 32 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, requiring network-attached storage configurations, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a contrast between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is weak, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1104.08 and a poor single-threaded gzip compression rate of 19.19 GB/sec. Conversely, the 48 dedicated cores deliver average multi-core performance, achieving a stress-ng multi-core score of 35393.62 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 149.01 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth is average, measuring 1968.52 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 98.26 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The system also demonstrates average performance in database operations, with Redis SET throughput at 33.17 million operations per second and static web serving at 22.34 GB/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a dense GPU-to-CPU allocation suitable for parallel processing without the cost overhead of newer GPU architectures. The primary tradeoffs include weak single-threaded performance and the complete absence of local storage. This server is best suited for workloads such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, multi-threaded data processing, and parallel computing tasks that leverage GPU acceleration.
